THREE NUMBERS, per the rule that a hold-out is only a hold-out if the truth side is independent of the route under test: (1) AS-RUN, all 1,200 truth cells: E2 strict 2.01%%, E2b 1.67%%. (2) THIS CAMPAIGN EXCLUDED: identical, and not by luck -- MEASURED, 0 of its 221 fills appear in the pinned truth base. (3) EVERY AGGREGATOR-DERIVED TRUTH CELL EXCLUDED, by glob over agg_pat_cell_fills + mc_*_fills + fav14_pat_std_fills (7,725 cells, of which 83 = 6.9%% of this truth base): E2 strict 2.74%%, **E2b 2.15%%**. ★ TREAT 2.15%% AS THE REAL NUMBER. The excluded subset scores 0.00%% in BOTH settings -- the tautology of MC agreeing with itself -- and it was diluting the headline; the 1.67%% first reported is not wrong, it is measured against a partly circular yardstick. What does NOT change is the ORDERING (E2b still beats strict on the independent subset) and the identical mismatch SETS, which is what the E2b decision rested on. For context, measured the same way: 15.9%% of all stored pre-2009 patStd cells are aggregator-derived (1,964 of 12,317). ⚠️ NO CALIBRATION BASE EXISTS BEFORE 2002 -- the store holds 120 rows in 2001 and none earlier -- so E2b is not calibrated for 2000-2001 and cannot be. ⚠️⚠️ VINTAGE, the axis this gate cannot arbitrate at all: audits of MC-derived cells of this era against archived NSE exchange pages measured 11.8%% (peer, 85 adjudicable) and 20.0%% (revenue side, 90 adjudicable) disagreeing, ALL healed TO the archive (§108). Expect a rate in that range on these cells wherever an archived page exists; a cell with no page is an EVIDENCE GAP, not agreement.
